meta.name: folklore-variant-evidence
meta.description: Retrieve ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and review source-linked public evidence and literature for one supported GRCh38 germline nuclear SNV or simple indel through Folklore Clinical Variant Interpretation MCP. Use when a scientific agent must branch deterministically on resolved, ambiguous, not-found, invalid, unsupported, or unavailable variant outcomes; chain a resolved public variant into related literature or publication details; or preserve evidence provenance without accepting patient, phenotype, family, segregation, or private case data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询基因与疾病的 ClinGen 证据,核对变异相关文献出处
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在遗传变异解读中需要核对公开证据与文献来源。
copy.tagline_en: Look up ClinGen gene-disease assertions and trace the literature behind a variant
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify public evidence and sources while interpreting genetic variants.

howto.what: 连上 Folklore MCP 后,Claude 可按公开基因或疾病查 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言,并对单个 GRCh38 胚系 SNV 或简单 indel 取公开证据与文献,按 resolved、ambiguous 等返回状态分支处理,不改写状态。
howto.when: 当你要求查某个公开基因或疾病的关联、对单个 GRCh38 胚系 SNV 或简单 indel 取公开证据,或把已解析变异串到文献时接管。只接受公开标识符,不收患者与家系数据。

say.text: 用 GRCh38 查 rs80357914 的公开变异证据,并列出返回状态
say.note: 若为 ambiguous 会停下等你选择

say.text: 查 BRCA1 的 ClinGen 基因-疾病有效性断言,附来源链接
say.note: 返回断言,不分类具体变异

say.text: 把解析出的 canonical_key 串到变异相关文献
say.note: 每条结果会标出匹配类型

howto.what_en: Via Folklore MCP, Claude retrieves ClinGen gene-disease validity assertions for a public gene or disease, and public source-linked evidence and literature for one GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel, branching on each returned status.
howto.when_en: Triggers for a public gene-disease association, public evidence on one GRCh38 germline SNV or simple indel, or chaining a resolved variant into literature. Public identifiers only; no patient data.

say_en.text: Search public variant evidence for rs80357914 on GRCh38 and show its status
say_en.note: An ambiguous result stops for your selection.

say_en.text: Look up ClinGen gene-disease validity for BRCA1 with source links
say_en.note: Returns assertions; it does not classify a variant.

say_en.text: Chain the resolved canonical_key into variant literature
say_en.note: Uses GRCh38; each result shows its match type.
